Supported Countries

Lemon Squeezy supports merchants and affiliates in hundreds of countries. Find out if your country is supported for payouts and purchases.

Lemon Squeezy can offer services to merchants and affiliates who can receive bank or PayPal payouts in one of the hundreds of countries we support.

We currently allow purchases from all countries except those listed in our unsupported customer countries list.

If you don’t see your country listed by PayPal or in the list below, sorry, you won’t be able to use Lemon Squeezy at this time (either as a merchant or an affiliate).

  • PayPal payouts are supported in 200+ countries and regions.

If you are a merchant from India without an approved Stripe account, you will have to use PayPal for payouts. See this Stripe doc for more info.
